items.title: Earl Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 7, 2002
items.q: Joe Glaser would do the booking but Hines would handle all the details.

ctx.x: That’s right it never got onto—

So I was just reading somebody’s book — his book — and it was talking about that band and what a great band it was. He said Jesus, everybody in there was full of arrangers and everybody was gung ho and everybody could play, and all he had to do — he had to learn as a matter of fact. But his mind was always open. He was always studying. If some piano player would come by and do something he’d go, “How’d you do that? What was that chord?” So he was very forward thinking and had amazing technique. I learned a lot…
